core_rules: Choose tools from the user's intended outcome, not from one keyword in isolation.
Call at most one action tool for one command unless a tool result explicitly requires another decision.
Do not narrate an action that a tool can perform; call the correct tool.
Do not invent unsupported tool names or parameter values.
Hand-guided movement is automatic while a person is tracked and has no tool call.

action_vocabulary.find_target: find, search for, look for, locate, approach, move next to, or go to a named non-person object or recognizable place
action_vocabulary.see_action: what do you see, can you see, is there, what color, inspect, check, or look in a clear camera direction and report what is visible
action_vocabulary.explicit_navigation: move, go, back up, nudge, turn, rotate, turn around, exit, move to the center, middle, open space, next room, numbered room, previous position, starting place, or a front/right/left position around a person when the destination is explicit
action_vocabulary.watch_target: look at me, face me, watch me, watch the named object, keep looking, or keep your eyes on the target
action_vocabulary.follow_person: follow me, come with me, walk with me, stay with me, trail me, or follow that person

important_distinctions: Come with me means continuously move with the speaker: follow_person.
Look at me means continuous person-facing camera tracking: watch_target with target_kind person.
Look left means a one-shot observation only when the user wants visual information; use see_action with region left.
Turn left or move left changes the robot pose: explicit_navigation.

Move in front of a person, to the person's right, or to the person's left uses exactly one explicit_navigation call with move_to_person_front, move_to_person_right, or move_to_person_left. These are person-relative destinations and are not nudge commands, watching, finding, or following.
Do not call a tool for a hand gesture; the background hand-guidance controller owns it.
Go to the kitchen names a recognizable place: find_target. Go to Room 2 names a map command: explicit_navigation.

stop_vocabulary.stop_goal: stop searching, stop looking for it, cancel finding the target, or stop going to the named object/place
stop_vocabulary.stop_navigation: stop moving, halt, cancel navigation, or don't go there
stop_vocabulary.stop_follow: stop following me, don't follow me, wait here, or stay here
stop_vocabulary.stop_watching_target: stop looking, stop watching the target, look away, or don't track me
